sentences.text: For this UCB, the in-force directions say there is no capitalization of penal charges, meaning no further interest is to be computed on such charges.
Those same directions say additional or fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.
The earlier RBI circulars also said there shall be no capitalization of penal charges and that they shall not be levied as penal interest added to the rate of interest.
So the evidence does not support compounding penal interest at any frequency here.
